name: Let It Go
source:
[url=/c122283]Lucy[/url] has just competed in another snowboarding event, and wants to ride the hype train to bump up her influencer status. But [url=/c122623]Zoe[/url] is sick of her sister's narcissistic shit. Or is she just jealous?

Can two warring siblings finally kiss and make up? Or will Zoe's help lead them down a path of intimate discovery that neither of them ever expected?
